Known as the “City of the Wind”, Essaouira is famous for its historic Medina, relaxed atmosphere, and a fascinating blend of Moroccan and Mediterranean influences.
During this **4-day / 3-night experience**, participants will stay in traditional riads located inside the Medina, explore the city’s vibrant streets, and train at Club des Douars, one of the most scenic padel clubs in the region.

This experience is designed for players who want to train, discover authentic Moroccan culture, and enjoy a unique lifestyle experience in one of the most atmospheric destinations in North Africa.
